name: Tomato
overview: A warm-season vegetable. Variety, local climate, drainage, and disease pressure affect the growing plan.
checklist: Use healthy seed or seedlings suited to the local season.
Prefer well-drained soil and avoid prolonged waterlogging.
Monitor regularly for pests and diseases; use locally approved integrated pest-management advice.
caution: Fertilizer dose and spray schedules depend on soil tests, variety, crop stage, and local recommendations.

name: Onion
overview: Onion production depends strongly on variety, day length, season, irrigation, and curing conditions.
checklist: Choose a variety recommended for your region and season.
Maintain suitable moisture while avoiding waterlogging.
Harvest and cure bulbs according to local extension guidance.
caution: Nutrient timing and irrigation needs vary by season and production system.

name: Potato
overview: Potato performance depends on seed-tuber health, temperature, soil drainage, and disease management.
checklist: Use healthy, certified or otherwise trusted seed tubers.
Use soil-test information to guide nutrient planning.
Check local advisories for late blight and other crop-health risks.
caution: Do not use a generic fertilizer or pesticide dose as a substitute for local agronomic advice.

name: Maize
overview: Maize recommendations vary by season, hybrid, rainfall, irrigation, and intended use.
checklist: Select a locally recommended hybrid or variety.
Plan sowing and nutrient application using local crop advisories.
Monitor moisture and weeds during early growth.
caution: Nutrient rates should be based on the local package of practices and soil-test results.

name: Rice / Paddy
overview: Rice practices differ across transplanted, direct-seeded, irrigated, and rainfed systems.
checklist: Use the method and variety recommended for your agro-climatic zone.
Use local guidance for water management and nutrient timing.
Check current district advisories for weather-related operations.
caution: Water and fertilizer practices are system-specific; avoid applying one region’s schedule everywhere.

name: Bottle gourd
overview: A warm-season cucurbit whose variety, sowing window, spacing, and nutrient needs vary by region.
checklist: Check the recommended sowing window for your district.
Provide suitable drainage and support where required.
Monitor vines, flowers, and fruits for pests and disease symptoms.
caution: Use regional crop recommendations for seed rate, spacing, and nutrient quantities.

name: Chilli
overview: Chilli growing practices vary with variety, season, local climate, and whether the crop is rainfed or irrigated.
checklist: Select regionally recommended seed or seedlings.
Maintain drainage and monitor for thrips, mites, and disease symptoms.
Use integrated pest-management advice from local extension services.
caution: Do not apply pesticide or fertilizer rates without checking local recommendations and product labels.

name: Groundnut
overview: Groundnut is sensitive to soil conditions and moisture around flowering and pod development.
checklist: Choose a variety suited to the local season and soil.
Use soil testing to guide nutrient planning.
Monitor crop moisture and locally important pests and diseases.
caution: Nutrient and gypsum recommendations depend on soil type and regional guidance.
